name: Forgefather's Half-Plate
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 251
Aura faint abjuration, divination, evocation, and transmutation CL 3rd
Slot armor; Price 4,180 gp; Weight 50 lbs.
Description
This +1 half-plate is usually sized for a dwarf and decorated with one or more sacred hammer symbols of Torag. Once per day, the wearer may use mending, protection from evil, and sparkAPG. Once per day as a full-round action, the wearer can attempt a Knowledge check (with a +10 bonus) to identify a creature he is currently in combat with, even if he possesses no ranks in the appropriate Knowledge skill.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, know the enemyUM, mending, protection from evil, sparkAPG; Price 2,465 gp
